claims.text: Nico Robin is the archaeologist of the Straw Hat Pirates, formerly associated with Baroque Works under the alias Miss All Sunday, and a survivor of Ohara.
Robin is known by the epithet Devil Child and is able to read and decipher Poneglyphs, including the forbidden ancient script.
Robin ate the Hana Hana no Mi, a Paramecia Devil Fruit that lets her sprout and replicate parts of her body on almost any surface and manipulate the replicated parts remotely.
Her defining combat style is submission-oriented grappling: she sprouts arms at specific points on an opponent to immobilize, disarm, choke, twist, slam, or apply joint locks and back-breaking holds.
The Hana Hana no Mi can affect multiple opponents at once and can be used offensively, defensively, for mobility, and for reconnaissance by sprouting eyes or ears at remote locations.

Before the timeskip, Robin is documented as sprouting up to one hundred arms and combining them into larger constructs; after the timeskip, she can sprout up to one thousand body parts and create gigantic limbs.
Robin can sprout body parts other than arms, including eyes, ears, legs, feet, wings, nets, and tree-like masses of limbs.
After the timeskip, Robin can create Cuerpo Fleur, a full-body duplicate that can move independently, dissipate into petals, generate clothing, and sprout additional limbs.
Robin learned to incorporate palm strikes based on Fish-Man Karate during her training with the Revolutionary Army, adding shockwave-producing attacks to her grappling-based style.

Named basic sprouting techniques include Dos Fleur, Tres Fleur, Cinco Fleur, Seis Fleur, Ocho Fleur, Nueve Fleur, Once Fleur, Doce Fleur, Dieciséis Fleur, Veinte Fleur, Treinta Fleur, Ochenta Fleur, Cien Fleur, Mil Fleur, Cuarenta Fleur, and Diez Fleur; the names generally indicate the number of sprouted arms or body parts.

Named arm techniques include Clutch, Twist, Slap, Flip, Slam, Strangle, Hang, Calendula, Delphinium, Spider Net, Big Tree, Slalom Vine, Grab, Hold, Shock, and Spank, with variants differing by the number, placement, or combination of sprouted limbs.

Named non-arm techniques include Ojos Fleur for sprouting eyes, Pierna Fleur for sprouting feet or legs, Oreja Fleur for sprouting ears, and Robi-Cho Suplex, a combination technique performed with Chopper.
Pre-timeskip large-limb techniques include Ochenta Fleur: Cuatro Manos, Dos Manos, Cien Fleur: Delphinium, Cien Fleur: Wing, Spider Net, Big Tree, and their Hold, Clutch, and Shock variants.

Post-timeskip large-limb techniques include Mil Fleur: Gigantesco Mano, Gigantesco Mano: Stomp, Gigantesco Mano: Spank, Campo de Flores, Cuarenta Fleur: Cuatro Mano, Cuatro Mano: Spank, Cinco Mano: Spank, Tres Mano: Freesia, and related Hold or Clutch variants.

Cuerpo Fleur techniques include Doble Clutch, which combines Robin's body and clone in a simultaneous hold, and Gigante Fleur: Sea Serpent, which creates a giant upper-body duplicate with additional giant limbs.

Robin's transformation-like forms found by the end of Wano include Gigante Fleur and Demonio Fleur. Demonio Fleur creates a giant devil-like duplicate with extra appendages, wings, horns, fangs, and shaded skin.
Demonio Fleur's named finishing technique is Gran Jacuzzi Clutch, in which the demonic duplicate and its limbs secure the opponent in a grappling hold.
Fish-Man Karate: Giganteum creates a giant arm and an upward palm strike that generates a circular shockwave and wider internal damage.
The Hana Hana no Mi transfers damage, injury, strain, and certain Devil Fruit effects inflicted on sprouted body parts to Robin's real body, even when the replicated parts are distant.
Sprouted body parts are bound to the surfaces where they appear and cannot freely move from their points of origin; Robin also cannot sprout limbs where there is insufficient room.

Robin's replicated limbs reflect her own physical strength, so especially heavy opponents may be difficult to restrain. Giant constructs also make larger targets and can exhaust her more quickly when used repeatedly.

Robin generally needs to know where a target or object is, or have it within effective view, to sprout limbs accurately. A sufficiently fast target can escape her sight and cause the limbs to appear elsewhere.
Fire can burn usable surfaces and sprouted limbs, limiting Robin's ability to manifest them; seawater and seastone impose the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
In the battle against Black Maria, burning nets were used to restrict the surfaces from which Robin could sprout limbs, and attacks against her giant limbs injured her real body.
The supplied pages document Robin's use of Demonio Fleur and Gran Jacuzzi Clutch against Black Maria during the Wano Country arc.
Robin's Wano Country identity includes the temporary alias O-Robi and geisha or kunoichi disguises, but these are disguises or aliases rather than separate forms or continuities.
